UserBackup.title: User Workspace Backup
UserBackup.description: Consolidated cloud backup of user books, sessions, projects, and achievements to guarantee persistence across devices.

userId.description: The unique ID of the user.

challengeDays.description: The number of days in the current challenge.

startDate.description: The starting date of the current challenge.

booksCount.description: The number of books currently in the workspace.

sessionsCount.description: The number of writing sessions recorded.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when this backup was uploaded.

rawBooksJson.description: Consolidated JSON string of books to prevent Firestore document size limit issues.

rawSessionsJson.description: Consolidated JSON string of writing sessions to prevent Firestore document size limit issues.

rawProjectsJson.description: Consolidated JSON string of projects in the workspace.

rawBadgesJson.description: Consolidated JSON string of unlocked and locked badges.

/users/{userId}/backups/current.description: Consolidated backup document for a single user's workspace.
